name: cce-performance-tests
description: What: performance tests of the CCE collector, matcher and Step SLA services (k6 in Docker + one Node.js CLI for settings, preflight, runs, reports, baselines and cleanup). How: npm test / npm run lint / npm run perf -- run local collector smoke (or scripts/run-test.sh local collector smoke). Needs: Node 22, Docker with the image cce-load-tests/k6:2.3.0-kafka2.2.0, a CCE stack (config/environments/<env>.json), DB_PASSWORD in the environment for database checks. Outputs: results/<subject>-<test-type>-<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>/ (result.json, report.md, …) and baselines/<name>.json.

scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && node tools/cli.mjs lint-headers && npm run lint:shell
